sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At the heart of Tori lies its core gameplay mechanics, which are designed to challenge your reflexes, test your skills, and keep you engaged for hours on end. The game's central premise revolves around guiding Tori, the game's protagonist, through a series of increasingly difficult levels, collecting orange balls while avoiding enemies, spikes, and ground saws. The game's controls are simple yet intuitive, allowing players to use the WASD or arrow keys to move Tori, as well as the W or up arrow key twice for a double jump.

The gameplay itself is fast-paced and action-packed, with Tori facing off against hordes of enemies, navigating treacherous terrain, and solving puzzles to progress through the levels.
